sections.title: Where to, where in, where from
sections.content: *túrázik* ("to hike") is an *-ik* verb like *dolgozik*: *túrázom*, *túrázunk*. A hike is also a good way to practise the three-way contrast you know from Unit 6: *hol?* (*-n*, *-ban*), *hová?* (*-ra*, *-ba*) and *honnan?* (*-ról*, *-ból*). You know *kirándul* ("to go on a trip") from A1 and *piknikezik* from Unit 11.

sections.title: Three questions, three endings
rows: We are going to the mountain.
We are going into the forest.

items.english: At the weekend we hike on the mountain.
The view from the mountain is beautiful.
On Sunday we have a picnic in nature.

sections.content: *kirándulni* is any trip out of town, even a picnic in the park. *túrázni* is walking a route, usually in hills or forest. The place words stay the same: *hegy* takes *-n/-ra/-ről*, *erdő* takes *-ben/-be/-ből*.
